title: Buyer/Procurement Analyst
jd:
ANDERSEN CORPORATION SUMMARY: At Andersen, we see possibility everywhere, every day and in everything we do. The possibility for our employees to achieve their full potential, for our communities to be stronger and for everyone to have a healthier, happier place to live. Our portfolio of brands — Andersen Windows & Doors, Renewal by Andersen and Fenetres MQ — is crafted to serve customers across the new residential, home improvement and light commercial building sector. Join our more than 13,000 employees who are inspired every day to deliver exceptional experiences that turn possibility into reality. JOB DESCRIPTION: Summary: This role is responsible for procuring raw materials, components, and packaging required to support manufacturing operations. This role ensures material availability while balancing inventory levels, quality, and supplier performance. This position works closely with production planning, operations, logistics, engineering, and suppliers to maintain uninterrupted production in a manufacturing environment.. T here is no relocation or sponsorship available for this position. This position is 100% onsite and candidate must be local to the TX area. Key Responsibilities Plan and execute the purchase of components and supplier to meet production schedules and customer demand. Perform cycle counts, monitor inventory levels and place purchase orders to maintain appropriate stock levels while minimizing excess inventory. Review replenishment recommendations and adjust purchasing plans based on demand, production requirements, and supplier constraints. Expedite critical orders and resolve material shortages to prevent production disruptions. Develop and maintain strong relationships with suppliers to ensure delivery, quality, and service expectations are met. Monitor supplier performance and drive corrective actions related to delivery, quality, or service issues. Coordinate with receiving, production, scheduling, and logistics teams to ensure timely material flow. MUST HAVE QUALIFICATIONS: Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience. Degree in Supply Chain, Engineering or Information Systems is preferred 6-8 years combine experience in Sourcing, Operations, Logistics Working knowledge of relevant supply chain technologies such as ERP, Manufacturing Execution Systems, Warehouse Management Systems, data mining, and data reporting. Strong computer skills and experience with Excel, Word, and Outlook Seeks opportunities to learn from others with more experience and tenure in the organization Actively participates in creation and progress of Individual Development Plan NICE-TO-HAVE QUALIFICATIONS: Proficient in utilizing lean tools and methodology for problem-solving and continuous improvement Prior experience working in a manufacturing environment Experience with high-volume production planning Effective communication skills through written, verbal, and listening techniques Experience with PowerBI, ERP, Excel, preferred 5-10% Travel to other Andersen location in GA, AZ, WI, TX, OH as needed. COMPENSATION: Pay is based on several factors including but not limited to work experience, education, geographic location, certifications, etc. Your recruiter can share more about the specific compensation package role are expected to earn $68K-$102K annually. PAY RANGE: $69,840.00 - $104,760.00

 CULTURE AND BENEFITS: At Andersen, we believe our people are at the heart of everything we do. Every day, their talent, dedication and passion enables us to be the most trusted window & door company. To support our employees, we provide a comprehensive Total Rewards Package – a thoughtful combination of pay and benefits that reflects our commitment to investing in each team member’s wellbeing and success. While specific benefits may vary by position or location, we’re proud to offer a comprehensive Total Rewards Package designed to support your well‑being, growth, and future. Our benefits include: 401 (k) Plan, Employer Fixed Contributions & Company Matching Profit Sharing* Medical, Dental and Vision Coverage* Flexible Spending Accounts (FSAs)*, Health Savings Account (HSA) and Health Reimbursement Account (HRA) Life Insurance Paid Time Off & Paid Holidays Paid Maternity Leave & Paid Parental Leave* Career Growth Planning & Nationwide Career Opportunities *For employees covered by a collective bargaining agreement, some benefits may differ or may not be available based on the terms of the agreement. PROFIT SHARING: In 2026 Andersen has set a profit-sharing target of $3,600 per eligible employee, prorated as appropriate. Profit Sharing will be paid out in quarterly installments to provide eligible employees with payments throughout the year, with payment amounts tied to quarterly operating profit performance.
